content:
support-olivia: FYI customer acme-123 reports "usage streak" lines missing on Console for 2024-03-03 -> 2024-03-09. They saw zeros for several hours after we ran an ETL retry/backfill. Tenant: acme-123. Backfill job id: backfill-20240309-7. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snap/abc123

data-jordan: looking. can you paste sample API request ids or a screenshot of the console timeseries hover? did they run any ad-hoc queries? any errors in the pipeline around the backfill time?

support-olivia: sending logs from the backfill worker:
```
2024-03-09T02:11:47Z WARN consumer-group acme-cdc partition=12 lag=120345, restarting consumer
2024-03-09T02:12:03Z ERROR backfill-processor id=backfill-20240309-7 write_timeout: timeout writing 415 rows to hourly_rollups
2024-03-09T02:12:45Z INFO backfill-processor retrying batch after io error
```

eng-maria: thanks. initial hypothesis: the retry rewound Kafka offsets and some hourly aggregation windows were marked processed/dropped during a failure window. @sre-sam can you confirm connector restarts/offset rewinds for acme-cdc around 02:10-02:20Z?

sre-sam: checking connector status now. connector acme-cdc shows restart at 2024-03-09T02:12:01Z with these controller logs:
```
controller: restart detected for connector=acme-cdc, reason=502 from compaction service
kafka.consumer: last_committed_offset=34567890, current_offset=34566700
```
consumer-lag peaked ~120k during restart.

etl-bot: Backfill job backfill-20240309-7 finished: status=SUCCESS rows_processed=1234567 duration=00:58:12

data-jordan: quick DB check — running rollup counts for tenant:
```
SELECT hour, coalesce(sum(count),0) as cnt
FROM hourly_rollups
WHERE tenant_id='acme-123' AND hour BETWEEN '2024-03-03' AND '2024-03-09'
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
```
results show hours 2024-03-05T04:00Z and 2024-03-06T05:00Z have zero rows (others populated).

support-olivia: customer is escalating: invoicing for their reserved plan looks low for the period. they want ETA.

product-tyler: short mitigation: show a 'data delayed' badge on tenant dashboards and pause auto-billing adjustments until we confirm restored rows. can support do interim comms? @support-olivia

support-olivia: will notify customer: "we've begun a targeted replay and will restore missing hours; holding billing adjustments until confirmed." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eng-maria: plan of action:
1) replay raw events for acme-123 for affected hours from archived parquet -> replay job replay-20240310 (targeted)
2) regenerate hourly_rollups for those hours
3) put a console banner indicating "data delayed for acme-123"
4) postmortem + followups (offset checkpointing, compaction retry alerting)

sre-sam: kicked off replay command on infra:
`/opt/ops/run_replay --tenant acme-123 --start 2024-03-03 --end 2024-03-09 --job replay-20240310`
ETA ~45m. I also restarted the parquet compaction service and fixed a transient 502 from the compactor.

data-jordan: replay finished — logs:
```
2024-03-10T03:12:01Z INFO replay-20240310 rows_replayed=55432 regenerated_hours=2
2024-03-10T03:12:05Z INFO hourly_rollups updated for hours: 2024-03-05T04:00Z, 2024-03-06T05:00Z
```

support-olivia: I confirmed with customer; dashboard lines reappeared and billing numbers updated. they say "thanks, looks fixed" :white_check_mark:

eng-maria: taking for postmortem. root cause: transient compaction service 502 caused connector restart which rewound offsets and triggered an ETL retry that did not re-validate processed windows. action items:
- add durable offset checkpointing and a guard to prevent marking hourly windows as processed when write timeouts occur
- alert on compaction 5xx and connector restarts (pager to oncall)
- add a post-replay validation job for backfills

support-olivia: marking thread resolved on customer side. will follow up with customer-facing summary and ETA for postmortem RFC.

sre-sam: resolved in infra, monitoring added. closing oncall ticket.

etl-bot: Incident note appended: incident/2024-03-09-compaction-retry-accel
